system: Yakıt & Hava Ölçümü (MAF, MAP, O2, ECT Sensörleri)
symptoms: O2 Sensor : Measures the oxygen level in the exhaust gases.
Heater Circuit : Ensures the sensor reaches its optimal operating temperature quickly for accurate readings.
Bank 2 : Refers to the side of the engine opposite to Bank 1, which typically contains cylinder 1.
Sensor 1 : The first O2 sensor located before the catalytic converter.
